title: Efficient Learning of Mechanism Designs and Compositionality
abstract: arXiv:2610.40005v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learning mechanism behaviour requires a representation of how connected parts jointly constrain motion. We study whether exposing reusable constraint subassemblies improves prediction from limited data. Assur-KB represents planar mechanisms through irreducible modules, boundary interfaces, and solve dependencies while retaining source geometry. Our theoretical results characterize transfer through module interfaces and establish physical limits arising from missing interface information and accumulated sensitivity. To test the representation claim directly, the experimental design compares matched mechanism-curve pairs across training budgets within the same multilayer-perceptron family. This controlled comparison establishes the utility of the complete representation in the evaluated learning setting. Assur-derived features provide a geometric-mean $1.8\times$ advantage in sample efficiency over flattened adjacency and position inputs a

translated_title: 机构设计的高效学习与组合性
translated_abstract: 学习机构行为需要对各连接部件如何共同约束运动进行表示。我们研究暴露可重用的约束子组件能否改善有限数据下的预测。Assur-KB 通过不可约模块、边界接口和求解依赖关系来表示平面机构，同时保留源几何信息。我们的理论结果通过模块接口刻画了迁移特性，并建立了由缺失接口信息和累积敏感性产生的物理极限。为了直接检验这一表示主张，实验设计在同一多层感知器系列内比较了不同训练预算下匹配的机构-曲线对。这一受控比较确立了完整表示在所评估的学习场景中的有效性。基于 Assur 衍生的特征在样本效率上相比扁平化的邻接和位置输入提供了几何平均 1.8 倍的优势。
tldr: 该论文提出 Assur-KB 表示方法，通过不可约模块、边界接口和求解依赖关系来编码平面机构，从理论和实验上证明了这种组合式表示在有限数据下比扁平化输入具有 1.8 倍的样本效率优势。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Assur-KB, a representation of planar mechanisms based on irreducible modules, boundary interfaces, and solve dependencies, and demonstrates both theoretically and empirically that this compositional representation achieves a 1.8× sample efficiency advantage over flattened inputs under limited data.
